title: Appending a unary marker
statement: For every $N\in\mathbb{N}$, changing cell $N+1$ of the unary tape with $N$ markers to a unit marker gives the unary tape with $N+1$ markers.
replaced:
Updating the unary tape with $N$ markers at cell $N+1$ with a unit marker yields the
unary tape with $N+1$ markers.
